d:
NEET is supposed to be about becoming a doctor.
Nobody tells you it can also make you fall in love.
FilterCopy presents "When Two NEET Students Fall In Love" - a heartwarming story of two ambitious students whose journey begins as a fierce competition for Rank 1 and slowly turns into something much more.
From solving mock tests and sharing notes, to late-night calls, coaching corridor encounters, and supporting each other through the toughest days of preparation - what starts as rivalry soon blossoms into love.
